_comment: Interactives that open a document when clicked: posters, books, plaques.
The client shows them with a kkt that only carries the document's id, measured in the capture
'abrir libro el escudo de feca y leerlo': the client sends iuu and the server answers
kkt { f2: 217 }, which is the book's document. Nothing else: neither title nor text travel, the
client has them in its own documents table.
The document is looked up in dofus3_data/documents.json, which pairs the id with the texts of the
title and of the content. 420 is 554597 'Oferta de trabajo' and 554600 'Se busca desratizador
para sanear la bodega de una taberna'.
Reading one is noted down in CharacterElements like any other interactive use, and from there
comes the afterElement condition of the NPCs' replies.

readables.why: The job offer of the Incarnam tavern. The guide says «Cliquez pour accepter l'offre» and document 420 is exactly that text. The element carries the same id on the two adjacent maps [0,-3] and [1,-3], which is what a building that spans both does; the map's other two odd candidates were discarded because drawing 32613 is the phoenix rocks and 42509 is the entrance door. It is a reasoned inference, not a measurement. It asks with the poster's own text (554600) and two replies that exist in the client: 27068 «Aceptar la oferta.» and 28887 «Rechazar.». Accepting is what records having read it; looking at it and walking away does not count, or the button would be an ornament. The poster's dialog is not measured in any capture: the guide says «Cliquez pour accepter l offre» and does not detail what it opens, so this part is ours.
